description.value: A developed BC Parks campground on Tudyah Lake in Northern BC, offering 36 sites with potable water and washrooms; opening and closing dates shift with weather, so confirm before planning.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Tudyah Lake is a real provincial park campground (listed as 'Tudyah Lake Park') in Northern BC, corroborating the OSM tourism=camp_site tag; OSM records capacity=36 and fee=yes. The website front page loaded but returned only site navigation with no park-specific amenity details, and all subpages returned 404 errors, so no optional amenities can be confirmed from website content.
